title: Deadline
summary: Shows time left and the exact moment in both your time zone and the owner's, so a deadline isn't missed to a time-zone slip or a misread midnight.
description: Shows time left plus the exact moment in your zone and the owner's, writes midnight as the end of the day before, and turns amber when close and red when overdue.
catches: Deadlines in another time zone, shown in both zones
Midnight deadlines misread as the following day
Deadlines that are close (urgentWithin) or already overdue
limits: Time left uses the visitor's clock unless you pass `now`
The deadline's zone is whatever you pass in ownerTimeZone
a11y: An overdue deadline is announced with role="alert"
Urgency is stated in words as well as colour
stops: Missed a deadline by a time zone
